clientNote: The exec plane and the control plane both run tmux ON the far machine, so the tmux that talks to a 3.7c server is that machine's own 3.7c. The shipping 3.7b client was built and present for the run, at build/vendor/tmux/bin/tmux, and build/probe-control-dialect.mjs measured it as a second program in the same run. It is never the client of the 3.7c server.
builtFrom: upstream tarball https://github.com/tmux/tmux/releases/download/3.7c/tmux-3.7c.tar.gz, 789431 bytes, sha256 7c60cae9a0e25288e2e24750aafc9e8800fc7fd4555e447e1b29ee4201cfb3bf, built by "node build/build-tmux-version.mjs 3.7c" with --enable-utf8proc and --disable-jemalloc. It is not Homebrew's build.
carriage: build/probe-execplane.mjs and build/probe-control-dialect.mjs, both over a real ssh carriage to a scratch sshd on 127.0.0.1, with the far side's program pointed at the built 3.7c by putting its directory first on PATH.

exec.listSessions: list-sessions -F '#{session_id}' answers "$0" and exit 0 on a server holding one session, and no rows with exit 0 on a running server holding none.
exec.displayMessageVersion: display-message -p '#{version}' answers "3.7c" and exit 0. Over the ssh carriage the machine reported "3.7c".
exec.showOptions: show-options -gv history-limit answers "25000" and exit 0. After the machine boot 12 of 12 server options stuck, and they stuck again after the server was ended and reborn.
